oracle_code:
def oracle(input):
    n = input
    n = n & 4294967295
    r = 0
    i = 0
    while i < 32:
        r = (r << 1) | (n & 1)
        n = n >> 1
        i += 1
    return r
stream_to_input_code:
def stream_to_input(symbols):
    n = 0
    i = 0
    while i < 4:
        n = (n << 8) | (symbols[i] & 255)
        i += 1
    return n

title: apps_4555
oracle_code:
def oracle(input):
    A, B, K = input
    res = []
    left_end = min(B, A + K - 1)
    x = A
    while x <= left_end:
        res.append(x)
        x += 1
    right_start = max(A, B - K + 1)
    x = right_start
    while x <= B:
        if x > left_end:
            res.append(x)
        x += 1
    return res
f2_guarantee_text: The hidden tail is empty because B equals A+2, so the interval contains exactly three integers.
